outcome: Fortuitously discovered uterine rupture (complete and incomplete)
cohort: The study included 41 cases of asymptomatic uterine rupture (27 complete, 14 incomplete) discovered incidentally during pregnancy or delivery.
finding: Prolonged labor (>220 minutes) was strongly associated with increased odds of complete uterine rupture, while lower maternal weight (<68 kg) correlated with reduced odds of incomplete uterine rupture.
gest_age: Measured; mean gestational age was longer in the incomplete uterine rupture group.
